atAGlance: Trà hoa cúc is chrysanthemum tea, floral and gentle, often chosen when you want a calming herbal cup instead of caffeine punch.
whatItIs: Trà hoa cúc is herbal tea made with chrysanthemum flowers. Expect chrysanthemum tea with a honeyed floral aroma, soft herbal body, and gentle sweetness.
howToEnjoy: Drink it hot for fragrance or iced for a cooling herbal cup.
howLocalsOrder: Order trà hoa cúc when you want a floral chrysanthemum tea, hot or iced. Ask ít đường if you want the light honeyed-herbal flavor to stay clean.
worthKnowing: In Vietnamese tea shops and cafes, chrysanthemum tea is gentle, floral, and cooling; it is often chosen when coffee feels too heavy.
